'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Matt Thornton LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matt Thorton
* '''Username:''' BrenDerlin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
